18.t: Working with data: an energy cycle
q: Which single step releases the most energy?
State Hess’s law in your own words.
The total energy change is the same whichever route is taken from the same start to the same end.
Calculate the energy change for C + ½O₂ → CO.
Explain why this value is hard to measure directly, and why Hess’s law helps.
Burning carbon in limited oxygen always makes some CO₂ too, so you cannot get pure CO. Hess’s law lets us calculate it from two reactions that can be measured.
